story.soThat: I can find and inspect sessions efficiently

tasks.task: Implement find_sessions() with filters (AC: #1) Add find_sessions() method to SessionManager Accept filter parameters: strategy, status, stage, since, has_findings Apply filters using AND logic Return list of matching sessions
Update CLI session list command (AC: #1) Add Click options for each filter Call find_sessions() with filter values Display results in table or json format

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Session list with filters implemented - --strategy name, --status status, --stage stage, --since date, --has-findings filters available
Session show command with details - Displays full session metadata, progress timeline with timestamps, findings summary (count by classification), layers completed vs pending
Session findings command - rustybt-validate session findings session_id lists all findings with ID, layer, classification, description. Shows unclassified findings prominently
Output format options - --format table (default) for human-readable, --format json for programmatic use. Both formats supported by list, show, findings commands
Unit tests verify query filtering logic

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR38: System can list all past sessions with summary information. FR39: System can retrieve detailed information about any past session.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Session management commands under session subgroup. Consistent filter patterns across commands. Table format with simple alignment (no external deps).

doc.title: Epic 3: Session Management System
doc.snippet: find_sessions() accepts Optional parameters (None = no filter), multiple filters combined with AND logic. Session show displays progress timeline with checkmarks.

doc.title: Story 3.1 - Session Progress Tracking
doc.snippet: SessionStage enum provides stage values for filtering. Session model has stage field for stage-based queries.

doc.title: Story 3.2 - Session Resumability
doc.snippet: _load_findings() helper can be reused for findings command to load findings from session.

Current session list command to extend with filter options.
Current session show command to extend with progress timeline and findings summary.
Session model with findings list. Used for findings command.

constraints.constraint: DEPENDS ON Story 3.1 - Uses SessionStage for stage-based filtering
No external dependencies for table formatting - use string formatting
JSON format uses stdlib json module
Multiple filters use AND logic (all must match)
Query reads from session directories - no separate index
Session metadata from session.yaml, findings from findings.yaml

interface.name: SessionManager.find_sessions
interface.signature: def find_sessions(self, strategy: Optional[str] = None, status: Optional[str] = None, stage: Optional[SessionStage] = None, since: Optional[datetime] = None, has_findings: bool = False) -> list[Session]

interface.name: CLI session findings
interface.signature: @session.command("findings") @click.argument("session_id") @click.option("--format") def session_findings(session_id: str, format: str) -> None

tests.standards: Use pytest fixtures to create test sessions with various statuses, stages, and findings. Test both filter logic and CLI output formatting.
